description:
You are a Sustainability Specialist preparing a quarterly board presentation. LibreOffice Impress is open with a 4-slide sustainability report presentation at /home/ga/Documents/Presentations/sustainability_report.odp.

Your task:
1. Add a new slide to the presentation (any position is fine)
2. Set the new slide's title to: 'Sustainability KPIs - Q3 2024'
3. Add the following four KPI data points as text content on the new slide:
   - Carbon Emissions: 12,450 tCO2e
   - Energy Efficiency: 94.2 kWh/sqft
   - Waste Diversion Rate: 78%
   - Water Usage: 1.2M gallons
4. Save the file (Ctrl+S) — keep it at the same path: /home/ga/Documents/Presentations/sustainability_report.odp
